sources.title: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-uncensored - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-uncensored This is a simple SFT finetune of Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 to remove censorship. I've tried to do the bare minimum training necessary to leave the model as pristine as possible. I'll follow this up with an "unslop" version that attempts to mitigate some of the slop.

sources.snippet: n0ctyx/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-Uncensored is a 4 billion parameter instruction-tuned causal language model based on the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 architecture, developed by n0ctyx.
